project.name: treetracker-admin-client
project.description: React web frontend for the Greenstand Treetracker Admin Panel: verifying, processing, and managing tree-planting captures, growers, and species collected by the Treetracker mobile app, plus grower messaging/surveys, stakeholder/organization management, and earnings/payments reporting, migrating off a legacy API to Greenstand microservices.

nodes.name: Authentication & Access Control
nodes.summary: Manages admin user login, session storage, and permission-gated navigation across the Admin Panel. Determines which routes and menu items a signed-in user can access based on their role and organization.

businessRules: Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login for any private route.
Route and menu visibility is derived per-user from hasPermission checks, not hardcoded.
A 'Freetown' feature flag permission gates a subset of experimental routes.
crossDomainInteractions: Gates every other domain's views via PrivateRoute
Supplies organization/session context consumed by all API modules

nodes.name: User Login
nodes.summary: Authenticates an admin user with credentials, stores the session, and redirects into the permission-gated app shell.

nodes.name: Render login form
nodes.summary: Displays the login form and validates username/password input on the entry-point Login page.

nodes.name: Submit credentials
nodes.summary: Handles form submission, calls the authentication API, and surfaces validation/API errors.

nodes.name: Establish session
nodes.summary: Stores the authenticated user and organization in AppContext and persists session state for subsequent API calls.

nodes.name: Persist session to storage
nodes.summary: Reads and writes the session object (user, token, organization) to local storage for reuse across page loads.

nodes.name: Redirect into app shell
nodes.summary: Once a session exists, PrivateRoute stops redirecting to /login and renders the requested page.

nodes.name: Permission-Gated Routing
nodes.summary: Builds the set of routes and menu items a user is allowed to see, and blocks direct navigation to unauthorized pages.

nodes.name: Build permission-gated route tree
nodes.summary: Constructs the app's route/menu tree for the current user by checking each candidate route against the permission model.

nodes.name: Check role permission
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether the current user's role grants access to a given permission key.

nodes.name: Check feature-flag permission
nodes.summary: Evaluates the 'Freetown' feature-flag permission for experimental routes.

nodes.name: Guard route render
nodes.summary: Wraps each route element, checking AppContext.user before rendering the target page or redirecting to /login.

nodes.name: Show unauthorized page
nodes.summary: Renders an error page when a user navigates to a route their permissions do not allow.

nodes.name: Capture Management
nodes.summary: Covers verifying, browsing, exporting, and de-duplicating tree-planting 'captures' (photo submissions) collected by the Treetracker mobile app. This is the core review workflow that turns raw field submissions into verified, tokenized tree records.

businessRules: A capture must be approved or rejected before it is tokenized.
Approve/reject actions support undo via an in-memory action history.
Filters (date, species, tag, organization) scope both the verify queue and the captures table.
The matching tool flags visually/geospatially similar captures as likely duplicates before approval.
crossDomainInteractions: Reads Species and Tags reference data for tagging captures
Captures are attributed to a Grower
Aggregated into Reporting & Analytics Dashboard stat cards

nodes.name: Verify Captures
nodes.summary: Reviews a paginated queue of unverified capture images and approves, rejects, or undoes verification decisions.

nodes.name: Compose verify view
nodes.summary: Sets the document title and wraps the verification UI in VerifyProvider, SpeciesProvider, and TagsProvider.

nodes.name: Load paginated capture queue
nodes.summary: Loads paginated capture images, tracks selection state, and exposes approve/approveAll/undo/undoAll actions with optimistic undo history.

nodes.name: Filter capture queue
nodes.summary: Provides capture search criteria (dates, verification/tokenization status, species, tags, organization) that re-trigger the queue fetch.

nodes.name: Tag capture
nodes.summary: Autosuggest input for attaching one or more tags to a capture during review.

nodes.name: View capture detail
nodes.summary: Opens a detail dialog showing the full capture image, metadata, and token status for close inspection before deciding.

nodes.name: Browse & Export Captures
nodes.summary: Lists already-processed captures in a filterable table and exports the current result set to CSV.

nodes.name: Compose captures view
nodes.summary: Composes CapturesProvider, SpeciesProvider, and TagsProvider with the filter header and table.

nodes.name: Load captures list
nodes.summary: Fetches and paginates the captures list scoped by the active filter.

nodes.name: Filter captures
nodes.summary: Renders the filter header controlling date, status, species, and tag criteria for the captures table.

nodes.name: Render captures table
nodes.summary: Renders the paginated captures table with formatted cell values.

nodes.name: Export captures to CSV
nodes.summary: Exports the currently filtered set of captures to a CSV file for download.

nodes.name: Match Duplicate Capture Images
nodes.summary: Surfaces visually and geospatially similar capture images so reviewers can identify likely duplicate submissions from the same grower before approval.

nodes.name: Compose matching tool view
nodes.summary: Wraps the capture matching UI in MatchingToolProvider and sets the document title.

nodes.name: Load and render candidate set
nodes.summary: Fetches candidate captures and drives the matching workspace UI.

nodes.name: Filter candidates by geolocation
nodes.summary: Filters the candidate tree set by proximity/geolocation criteria to narrow likely duplicates.

nodes.name: Render candidate image grid
nodes.summary: Displays candidate capture images in a comparable grid for visual review.

nodes.name: Compute geolocation distance
nodes.summary: Calculates distance between candidate capture locations to support duplicate scoring.

nodes.name: Grower Management
nodes.summary: Manages the tree planters ('growers') who submit captures: browsing and filtering the grower directory, and viewing/editing individual grower profiles, registrations, and organization assignment.

businessRules: A grower can be reassigned to a different stakeholder organization, including cleared to null.
Grower selfie photos are deduplicated from the grower's capture history rather than stored separately.
crossDomainInteractions: Captures are attributed to a Grower
Growers can belong to a Stakeholder organization
Earnings/payments are tied to a Grower
Aggregated into Reporting & Analytics Dashboard grower stats

nodes.name: Browse & Filter Growers
nodes.summary: Lists growers in a paginated grid with search/filter controls for finding a specific planter.

nodes.name: Compose growers view
nodes.summary: Sets the document title and composes GrowerProvider, SpeciesProvider, and TagsProvider with the filter header and grid.

nodes.name: Load grower list
nodes.summary: Provides grower list state loaded from the growers API, scoped by the active filter.

nodes.name: Filter growers
nodes.summary: Renders the header controls for filtering the grower directory.

nodes.name: Filter top growers by criteria
nodes.summary: Provides an advanced filter form (organization, date range, etc.) for narrowing the grower list.

nodes.name: Render grower grid
nodes.summary: Renders the paginated grid of grower cards.

nodes.name: Show grower tooltip
nodes.summary: Displays a hover tooltip with quick grower details from the grid.

nodes.name: View & Edit Grower Profile
nodes.summary: Loads a single grower's profile, registration devices, and photos, and allows editing profile fields including organization assignment.

nodes.name: Load grower detail
nodes.summary: Fetches and renders a single grower's full profile detail.

nodes.name: Fetch grower by id
nodes.summary: Fetches a single grower record by id from the API with authorization headers.

nodes.name: Fetch grower device registrations
nodes.summary: Fetches device registration records associated with the grower.

nodes.name: Fetch grower selfies
nodes.summary: Fetches and deduplicates the grower's selfie photo URLs from their capture history.

nodes.name: Edit grower profile form
nodes.summary: Renders an editable form dialog for updating grower profile fields.

nodes.name: Assign grower organization
nodes.summary: Allows assigning or clearing the grower's stakeholder organization.

nodes.name: Submit grower update
nodes.summary: Sends a PATCH request to update grower profile fields, normalizing a null organization sentinel value.

nodes.name: Reference Data Management
nodes.summary: Maintains the master/reference catalogs used throughout the app: tree species taxonomy and geographic regions (with GeoJSON boundaries). Both are simple CRUD catalogs referenced by captures, growers, and messaging.

businessRules: Duplicate species entries can be merged ('combined') rather than only deleted.
Region boundaries are stored and edited as GeoJSON.
Deleting a species or region requires an explicit confirmation dialog.
crossDomainInteractions: Species used to tag/filter Captures and Growers
Regions used to scope Messaging recipients and grower filters
Aggregated into Reporting & Analytics Dashboard species stats

nodes.name: Manage Species Catalog
nodes.summary: Views, edits, merges, and deletes entries in the tree species catalog.

nodes.name: Compose species view
nodes.summary: Sets the document title and renders SpeciesTable inside a SpeciesProvider context wrapper.

nodes.name: Load species list
nodes.summary: Loads the species catalog via react-query for use across the app.

nodes.name: Render species table
nodes.summary: Renders the paginated species data table with CRUD row actions.

nodes.name: Edit species entry
nodes.summary: Opens a modal with form validation for editing a species entry.

nodes.name: Combine duplicate species
nodes.summary: Opens a modal to merge one species entry into another, consolidating duplicate data.

nodes.name: Delete species entry
nodes.summary: Opens a confirmation dialog before deleting a species entry.

nodes.name: Manage Regions & Boundaries
nodes.summary: Views, edits (including GeoJSON boundary upload), and deletes geographic regions used to scope growers and messaging.

nodes.name: Compose regions view
nodes.summary: Updates the browser document title and renders the regions table inside a RegionProvider.

nodes.name: Load region list
nodes.summary: Provides region list state and CRUD operations loaded from the regions API.

nodes.name: Render region table
nodes.summary: Renders the paginated regions table with CRUD row actions.

nodes.name: Edit region boundary
nodes.summary: Opens a modal for editing region fields and uploading a GeoJSON boundary.

nodes.name: Delete region
nodes.summary: Opens a confirmation dialog before deleting a region.

nodes.name: Stakeholder & Organization Management
nodes.summary: Manages stakeholder organizations (NGOs, partners, groups) that growers and users belong to, including their parent/child organizational hierarchy and membership lists.

businessRules: Stakeholders can be organized in a parent/child hierarchy.
A stakeholder detail view lists both member growers and member users.
Adding a stakeholder requires form validation before submission.
crossDomainInteractions: Growers can be assigned to a Stakeholder organization
Used to scope Messaging recipients by organization
Session organization drives most region/messaging API scoping

nodes.name: Browse & Filter Stakeholders
nodes.summary: Lists stakeholder organizations in a sortable table with filter controls.

nodes.name: Compose stakeholders view
nodes.summary: Composes the Navbar, FilterBar, and StakeholderTable wrapped in StakeholdersProvider and GrowerProvider.

nodes.name: Load stakeholder list
nodes.summary: Provides stakeholder list state and CRUD operations loaded from the stakeholders API.

nodes.name: Filter stakeholders
nodes.summary: Provides filter-criteria state for narrowing the stakeholder list.

nodes.name: Render filter toolbar
nodes.summary: Renders the toolbar layout hosting the stakeholder filter controls.

nodes.name: Render stakeholder table
nodes.summary: Renders the sortable stakeholder table.

nodes.name: Manage Stakeholder Detail & Relationships
nodes.summary: Views and edits a single stakeholder's profile, parent/child organization hierarchy, and member growers/users.

nodes.name: Open stakeholder detail modal
nodes.summary: Renders the modal container for a single stakeholder's detail view.

nodes.name: Edit stakeholder header
nodes.summary: Renders an editable header form for the stakeholder's core fields with validation.

nodes.name: Manage stakeholder groups
nodes.summary: Manages parent/child organization group relationships for the stakeholder.

nodes.name: List parent/child relationships
nodes.summary: Displays list items for related parent/child stakeholder entries with delete confirmation.

nodes.name: Add New Stakeholder
nodes.summary: Creates a new stakeholder organization via a validated form.

nodes.name: Open add-stakeholder form
nodes.summary: Renders the modal form for creating a new stakeholder, with field validation.

nodes.name: Submit new stakeholder
nodes.summary: Submits the validated form to create the stakeholder record via the stakeholders API.

nodes.name: Messaging & Surveys
nodes.summary: Handles direct and broadcast messaging with growers, including announcements and grower surveys, plus visualization of aggregated survey responses.

businessRules: Announcements can be broadcast to many growers at once, distinct from a single-recipient message.
Survey responses are rendered as distinct chat-bubble types from plain sent/received messages.
Most messaging API calls are scoped by the session organization UUID.
crossDomainInteractions: Targets Growers as message recipients
Region lookups scope which growers can be messaged
Survey response aggregation feeds SurveyCharts visualizations

nodes.name: Send Message / Announcement
nodes.summary: Browses the message inbox, composes a new one-to-one message or a broadcast announcement, and sends it to grower(s).

nodes.name: Compose messaging view
nodes.summary: Renders the messaging page layout with Navbar and the Messaging container.

nodes.name: Manage messaging container state
nodes.summary: Coordinates inbox selection, active thread, and message-sending state for the messaging page.

nodes.name: Search inbox
nodes.summary: Provides search input for filtering the inbox thread list.

nodes.name: Select inbox thread
nodes.summary: Lists inbox threads and lets the reviewer select one to view/reply to.

nodes.name: Compose new message
nodes.summary: Opens a validated form modal to compose a new one-to-one message.

nodes.name: Compose broadcast announcement
nodes.summary: Opens a validated form with autocomplete recipient selection for broadcasting an announcement to many growers.

nodes.name: Render message thread
nodes.summary: Renders sent/received chat bubbles for the active thread, including a form for replying.

nodes.name: Conduct Grower Survey
nodes.summary: Builds and sends a survey to growers, then visualizes the aggregated responses.

nodes.name: Build survey form
nodes.summary: Renders a validated form for authoring survey questions to send to growers.

nodes.name: Send survey
nodes.summary: Wraps the survey form in a responsive modal and triggers the send action.

nodes.name: Render sent survey in thread
nodes.summary: Renders a sent survey as a distinct chat-bubble type in the message thread.

nodes.name: Render survey response
nodes.summary: Renders a grower's survey response as a distinct chat-bubble type in the message thread.

nodes.name: Visualize survey responses
nodes.summary: Aggregates and charts survey response data for review.

nodes.name: Earnings & Payments Reporting
nodes.summary: Tracks grower earnings from verified/tokenized captures and records payment confirmations, including bulk CSV-based adjustment of earnings and payment logs.

businessRules: Earnings can be patched individually or in bulk via CSV upload.
Logging a payment confirmation (id + method) updates the underlying earning record.
crossDomainInteractions: Earnings/payments are tied to a Grower
Relies on session-scoped authenticated API headers from Authentication domain

nodes.name: Review & Adjust Earnings
nodes.summary: Views paginated grower earnings and adjusts them individually or via bulk CSV upload.

nodes.name: Compose earnings view
nodes.summary: Renders the earnings page layout with Navbar and EarningsTable.

nodes.name: Render earnings table
nodes.summary: Fetches, paginates, and renders the earnings table with formatted rows.

nodes.name: Fetch earnings records
nodes.summary: Fetches earnings records from the API with query params and an authenticated bearer header.

nodes.name: Patch single earning
nodes.summary: Patches a single earning record via the API.

nodes.name: Batch-patch earnings via CSV
nodes.summary: Uploads a CSV file to batch-patch multiple earning records, wrapping upload errors.

nodes.name: Log Grower Payments
nodes.summary: Views payment records with date-range filtering, bulk CSV upload, and logs payment confirmation details against an earning.

nodes.name: Compose payments view
nodes.summary: Renders the payments page layout with Navbar and PaymentsTable.

nodes.name: Render payments table
nodes.summary: Renders the payments table with pagination, date-range filtering, and CSV batch upload with snackbar/error feedback.

nodes.name: Log payment confirmation
nodes.summary: Renders a form for logging a payment confirmation (id and method) and submits the update via the earnings API.

nodes.name: Submit payment update
nodes.summary: Submits the payment confirmation update as a patch to the underlying earning record.

nodes.name: Reporting & Analytics Dashboard
nodes.summary: Presents the admin home page with at-a-glance stat cards and date-range-filterable reporting cards summarizing captures, growers, trees, and species across the organization.

businessRules: Dashboard sections and menus are gated by user permissions.
Reporting cards show a top-N breakdown alongside the headline stat, with a 'see more' modal for detail.
crossDomainInteractions: Aggregates counts from Capture Management, Grower Management, and Reference Data Management domains
Gated by Authentication permissions per section

nodes.name: View Dashboard Overview
nodes.summary: Renders the home page's stat cards and reporting cards for a selected date range, summarizing captures, growers, trees, and species activity.

nodes.name: Compose dashboard home page
nodes.summary: Renders the dashboard home page: stat cards, reporting cards, a time-range picker, last-update timestamp, and permission-gated sections.

nodes.name: Fetch capture count stats
nodes.summary: Fetches total, unprocessed, and verified capture counts from the API for the stat cards.

nodes.name: Fetch grower count stat
nodes.summary: Fetches the total active grower count from the growers API.

nodes.name: Render stat card
nodes.summary: Renders a colored icon badge, numeric value (or loading spinner), and label for a single dashboard stat.

nodes.name: Load reporting card data
nodes.summary: Loads capture/grower/tree/species statistics and a top-N breakdown from the reporting API for the selected date range.

nodes.name: Render reporting card
nodes.summary: Renders a stat card with a top-4 breakdown list and a 'see more' detail modal.

edges.description: PrivateRoute gates the /verify, /captures, and /matching routes; session organization scopes capture API queries.
PrivateRoute gates the /growers route; permission checks control visible grower actions.
PrivateRoute gates the /messaging route; session organization UUID scopes most messaging API calls.
PrivateRoute gates the /earnings and /payments routes; authenticated bearer header required for earnings API calls.
Dashboard sections and menu items are gated by user permissions from getRoutes/hasPermission.
Verify and captures flows read Species and Tags reference data to tag and filter captures.
Captures are attributed to a grower; the matching tool links duplicate captures to the same grower.
Capture totals, unprocessed, and verified counts feed the dashboard stat and reporting cards.
GrowerOrganization assigns/clears a grower's stakeholder organization.
Earnings and payment records are tied to individual growers.
Grower counts and demographic breakdowns feed dashboard reporting cards.
Stakeholder detail view lists and manages member growers via GrowerListItem.
Messages and announcements are sent to growers as recipients.
Messaging API performs region lookups to scope recipient selection.
Species counts feed dashboard reporting cards.
